in_sanskrit.name: Alini
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Peaceful Wave
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Alini एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Alini is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'alankrita', which means 'decorated'. The name represents a peaceful wave, signifying calmness and tranquility. It is believed that Alini embodies the qualities of the Goddess Lakshmi, who is known for her nurturing, compassionate, and generous nature.
